extra_vocab.en: to give someone the right to have or do something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，will entitle the client to a credit 是合約修訂裡的正式用語：服務中斷超過四小時，客戶就「有權」獲得一筆抵扣額度。語氣正式，常見於合約與公告。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: entitle A to B（B 是名詞）或 entitle A to + V；被動 be entitled to 後面也是接名詞或原形動詞，to 之後不接 V-ing。

example.en: The extended warranty entitles customers to free repairs for two years.
example.zh: 延長保固讓顧客有權享有兩年的免費維修。

example.en: The previous agreement entitled each branch to its own budget.
example.zh: 先前的協議讓每間分公司都有權擁有自己的預算。

example.en: The clause entitling the client to a refund was added last week.
example.zh: 賦予客戶退款權利的條款是上週加進去的。

example.en: All members are entitled to a free annual check-up.
example.zh: 所有會員都有權享有一次免費年度檢查。

example.en: This warranty entitles you to a full refund within thirty days.
example.zh: 這項保固讓你有權在三十天內全額退款。

example.en: Customers with a membership card are entitled to a discount.
example.zh: 持有會員卡的顧客有權享有折扣。

example.en: The contract entitles the client to receive monthly reports.
example.zh: 合約讓客戶有權每月收到報告。

examples.en: Late delivery entitles the buyer to cancel the order.
examples.zh: 延遲交貨讓買方有權取消訂單。

examples.en: Full-time staff are entitled to twenty days of paid leave.
examples.zh: 全職員工有權享有二十天的帶薪假。

confusable.diff: enable 是「使能夠做到」，強調能力或條件；entitle 是「使有權利」，強調資格或法律、合約上的權利。

example.en: The new software enables staff to work from home.
example.zh: 新軟體讓員工能夠在家工作。

similar.diff: qualify for 是主語「符合資格而能取得」；entitle 是某事物「賦予對方權利」，主語通常是合約或規定。

example.en: Employees qualify for a bonus after one year of service.
example.zh: 員工服務滿一年後有資格領取獎金。

similar.diff: authorize 是「授權、批准」某人做某事；entitle 是「賦予享有某利益的權利」。

example.en: The manager authorized the purchase of new equipment.
example.zh: 經理批准了購買新設備。

example.en: Only full-time staff are eligible for this benefit.
example.zh: 只有全職員工有資格享有這項福利。

example.en: You will receive a full refund within ten days.
example.zh: 你會在十天內收到全額退款。

derived.link: 詞幹 title；en-（使成為）+ title，原意是「給某人名分或頭銜」，後來變成「賦予權利」
entitle + -ment，把「賦予權利」變名詞，像 manage → management

senses.en: to give someone the right to get or do something

example.en: A valid receipt entitles you to a free repair.
example.zh: 有效的收據讓你有權免費維修。

senses.en: to give a title to a book, report, or film
senses.distinguish: 常用被動 be entitled + 標題，指書、報告或文件的標題。

example.en: The report is entitled Annual Review of Customer Service.
example.zh: 這份報告的標題是《客戶服務年度回顧》。
